figures.title: A variable, a pointer to it, and a reference to it
figures.description: Three panels. The first shows a variable named score at address 4000 holding 84.0. The second shows a pointer named ptr at address 5000 holding the value 4000, with an arrow from ptr to score, and notes that ptr is a separate variable that stores an address. The third shows a reference named alias with no box of its own, drawn as a second label attached to the same box at address 4000, and notes that a reference is another name for an existing variable and occupies no storage of its own.
